name: hunters-concept-20261015c
_note: Jacob 15 Oct: "use another model" (local, any licence: these are placeholders an artist redoes). Local Ideogram 4 int8 (Comfy-Org/Ideogram-4, non commercial weights), template graph, the main model also runs the negative pass. Same race in all three, three costume ideas, one colourway. His look: goth, reptilian, own race (not a WoW copy), fit but fat, body armour, scales, chin skin goatee, very good looking, small horns, the Warden carries the war banner. Option 1 ran with the older summary (it named the Sovereign's hunters and the model wrote a small logo in the corner, painted out on the sheet); 2 and 3 ran with the hunters' name dropped and no text asked for.
background: Plain flat light grey studio background with no scenery, no floor and no texture. No text, no logo, no signature, no watermark anywhere.

options.label: cathedral plate
options.summary: Full body fantasy character concept art of a heavy reptilian standard bearer in massive gothic cathedral plate armour, painted in a clean, detailed concept art style.
options.prompt: An original reptilian humanoid from a proud warrior race, not a dragon. A broad, handsome reptilian head with a short blunt snout like a monitor lizard, a heavy brow ridge over intense amber eyes, fine dark charcoal scales with a faint silver sheen, two small curved horns swept back above the brow, and two thin fleshy flaps of scaled skin hanging down from either side of the chin like a forked goatee. Fit but fat: a huge, heavy, powerful build like a strongman or a heavyweight wrestler, very broad shoulders, a thick neck, a barrel chest and a big hard belly, thick muscular arms and legs. Striking and good looking in a dangerous way, calm and proud. Goth look. He wears massive black iron plate armour shaped like gothic cathedral architecture: pointed arches, buttress shaped pauldrons and tracery cut outs, trimmed with tarnished silver. He holds a tall processional war banner on a heavy pole: a long blood red banner hanging from a crossbar, with a black sigil and silver tassels. He stands full body in a three quarter view facing left, the whole figure from horns to feet and the whole banner in view. The banner's sigil is an abstract symbol, not letters.
